facts.label: Tanning Rack
facts.value: Blizzard says the more advanced Leatherworking recipes need a Tanning Rack, which is a camp object.

facts.label: Camp objects
facts.value: Camp Tent at skill 20, Tanning Rack at 140 (blueprint from Razorclaw the Butcher in Shadowfang Keep) and Sewing Machine at 300. The Camp Tent tops up rested XP to 5% of a level.

facts.label: Gear only you can make
facts.value: Some crafts are Bind on Pickup for the leatherworker, such as Wisdom's Leather Boots.

facts.label: Skill ranks
facts.value: Apprentice up to 75, Journeyman up to 150 (skill 50, level 10), Expert up to 225 (skill 125, level 20) and Artisan up to 300 (skill 200, level 35). 300 is the cap.

facts.label: Specialization (Classic baseline)
facts.value: Classic 1.12: choose Dragonscale, Elemental or Tribal Leatherworking.
facts.note: Forever guides list the same three.

facts.label: Merchant's Favor
facts.value: Favor recipes such as the Mystic Rugged kit (Honored, 90 Favor) come from the Azeroth Commerce Authority at Three Corners in western Redridge.

facts.label: Legacy
facts.value: The first time you reach 150, 225 and 300 in a craft you earn 1 Legacy point each. Working Overtime improves your skill-up chance.

facts.label: Core Armor Kit
facts.value: Core Armor Kit now gives +4 defense instead of +3, a small gain for tanks.

facts.label: Stat armor kits
facts.value: New kits add stats as well as armor: Light (Stamina), Forceful Medium (attack power), Mystic Medium (spell power) and Mystic Rugged.

facts.label: Not known yet
facts.note: Where the Sewing Machine blueprint drops.

facts.label: Not known yet
facts.note: Whether the Dragonscale, Elemental and Tribal quests are unchanged from Classic.

facts.label: Not known yet
facts.note: Which recipes need the Tanning Rack.

facts.label: Not known yet
facts.note: Whether a leatherworking mount-speed perk exists; it appears only in unverified perk lists.

facts.label: Professions window
facts.value: Professions have their own window, opened with K. Recipe lists can be searched and filtered, and you can track a recipe in the objectives frame.

facts.label: Camp buffs
facts.value: Profession camp objects give weaker copies of class buffs that do not stack with the real ones. You sit at the camp for at least 1 minute to get them.

facts.label: Campsite size
facts.value: A basic campsite holds 3 camp features, one per player. Cooking upgrades raise this to 5 or 10.

facts.label: Earning Merchant's Favor
facts.value: Fill Waylaid Crates (found in the world or bought on the Auction House) and hand the sealed crates to Marcy Baker of the Azeroth Commerce Authority at Three Corners in western Redridge. Craftsman's Writs add reputation.

facts.label: Profession title
facts.value: Crafters who reach 300 can earn a certification item that unlocks a profession title. Alliance players get it from the Azeroth Commerce Authority.

facts.label: Vendor prices
facts.value: Blizzard's beta notes say many profession-made items sell to vendors for less.
